spec.prompt:
CAMERA: the same isometric camera as the attached reference room: floor diamond seen from above at 30°, only the two BACK walls (left and right) are drawn, the front is open (cutaway), exactly like a life-simulation game interior.
Asset sheet of INTERIORS for a game set in Huambo, Angola. FIRST draw 9 EMPTY ROOMS (floor + two back walls, no furniture, all the same size and shape, each completely separated), in this order: (1) living room of an Angolan family home: tiled floor, painted walls with a window and curtains; (2) small grocery shop interior: cement floor, walls with shelves painted pale green; (3) bakery interior: white tiles, wooden bread shelves on the wall; (4) hotel room and lobby: beige walls, wooden floor; (5) bank branch interior: polished marble floor, light walls, bank logo panel; (6) mobile-phone shop interior: white walls with operator posters (Unitel, Movicel, Africell); (7) post office interior: yellow and red walls, counters; (8) government office interior: wood panelling, Angolan flag and official portrait frame on the wall; (9) courtroom interior: dark wood panelling, high windows.
THEN draw the FURNITURE, each piece as a separate isolated asset, grouped room by room in the same order, one row per room, with 2-3 extra small decorative items for each room (plants, frames, bins, fans, clocks) so that the sheet has more than 100 objects:
- for room (1): double bed with wax-print bedspread, terracotta sofa, TV on a wooden cabinet, gas stove with gas cylinder, white fridge, dining table with 4 chairs and flowered tablecloth, woven rug, wardrobe
- for room (2): shop counter with a scale and sweets, tall shelf full of cans, rice bags and oil bottles, soft-drink fridge (red), stack of crates of Cuca beer, plastic table with 4 plastic chairs, sacks of rice and beans
- for room (3): glass bread counter with pão, wood-fired bread oven, bread shelf with baguettes, cake display, small coffee machine on a counter, flour sacks
- for room (4): reception desk with a bell and key board, hotel double bed with white sheets, single bed, bedside table with lamp, armchair, luggage rack with suitcase
- for room (5): bank teller counter with glass partition, ATM machine, waiting chairs row, queue barrier posts, manager desk with computer, safe (cofre)
- for room (6): phone display counter with smartphones, wall display of phone cases, shop counter with cash register, SIM card stand, waiting stool, internet cafe computer desk
- for room (7): post office counter with window, wall of post office boxes (caixas postais), parcel scale, stack of parcels, mail sorting table, waiting bench
- for room (8): official desk with documents and stamp, visitor chairs, filing cabinet, Angolan flag on a stand, waiting bench, document counter with forms
- for room (9): judge bench (raised), witness stand, lawyer tables, public benches, court clerk desk, scales of justice statue
Every item fully separated by transparent space so each one can be cut out automatically. Same isometric angle and scale for all furniture.
